items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: Oh, and Escat comes in for the jam session?

ctx.x: No, she's there on Friday and Saturday.
Oh, and Escat comes in for the jam session? No, she has to work, so she takes off that night.

Same band, huh? Yeah, and then Escat is over on a Friday or Saturday. So, about the Silky side. That's on St. Peter and Toulouse. Somebody has a next section there on the far there. Right by the same time, huh? Yeah, there's a funeral home next door there.
